caption: The drawing features a ceramic bowl depicted from two perspectives: a top-down view of the interior and a side view of the exterior. The bowl is rendered in a light beige or cream color, adorned with intricate red floral designs. The inside view shows a central bouquet of flowers, surrounded by smaller floral patterns and decorative medallion shapes distributed along the rim. The exterior side view displays matching red floral motifs with similar medallion shapes spaced evenly around the surface and a decorative band near the top edge. The bowl rests on a slightly raised foot, and both the interior and exterior artwork is detailed with fine lines and delicate ornamentation. The drawing is signed and dated at the bottom, and the word "Inside" is written below the top-down view to indicate the perspective. The objects are set against a plain, light background bordered by a thin, red rectangular frame.
title: Cup
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
